headline: STOMPTOWN flattens twelve cities
lede: Jon's city-breaker prototype is a full arcade title: three original monsters, climbable towers, a news blimp that broadcasts your defeat, and a 12-city tour the autopilot wins replay-for-replay.

notes.text: #3094 shipped (PR #3112): STOMPTOWN registered at /stomptown with its own cast (GROG/ZARRA/FENRIS) — no names, credits or audio from the 1986 original, pinned by law in stompcheck.
stompcheck: 69 Node rules checks + 10 mutants, wired into the static gate; the pilot razes day 1 in ~28 s world time and wins the whole tour hash-for-hash (seed 11, 144,380).

Two real bugs the harness caught before you could: the sim's edge-detect read last tick's pads after overwriting them (no punch could ever fire), and the shell never opened the game-over card when the sim ended between frames.
QA polish pass filed as #3123: sequential floor-crush + dust, burning rubble, distinct monster silhouettes, per-city music variation, newspaper ceremony days.
